metadata.title: CancerOS Engineering Knowledge Map
metadata.authority: Navigation and derived synthesis, not a replacement for twelve signed-off specifications
metadata.scope: Hackathon breast cancer research digital twin
metadata.evidence_state: Synthesized from prior CancerOS design discussions and draft specifications. GitHub references are investigation candidates, not verified integrations.
rules_of_use: Retrieve domain nodes, related edges and invariants before every task.
Resolve conflicts against authoritative numbered specification, not this derivative map.
Never equate synthetic trajectory with validated clinical prognosis.
Require acceptance-test evidence before marking implementation tested.
Update map nodes when approved decisions change, with change log.

nodes.title: CancerOS breast cancer digital twin
nodes.description: Research-only, time-indexed, provenance-aware breast cancer imaging, simulation and interpretation prototype. NOT validated clinical decision support.
acceptance: Real MRI baseline to 3D lesion to dated simulated trajectory to evidence-linked interpretation works end-to-end

nodes.title: Clinical research data
nodes.description: Authentic patient, imaging and clinical evidence, normalized but source-preserving.

nodes.title: Medical imaging
nodes.description: MRI loading, preprocessing, masks, measurements, geometric representations and spatial quality.

nodes.title: Digital twin
nodes.description: Patient-specific observation states, meshes, timelines and branch isolation.

nodes.title: Synthetic longitudinal engine
nodes.description: Five hypothetical trajectories with treatment events, clinical values and uncertainty.

nodes.title: Multimodal intelligence
nodes.description: Deterministic analysis, constrained NLP, retrieval and validated narrative interpretation.

nodes.title: Researcher experience
nodes.description: Case browser, image views, 3D tumor, timeline, scenario and AI evidence panels.

nodes.title: Scientific evaluation
nodes.description: Technical correctness and honest real-data evaluation separate from simulation tests.

nodes.title: Platform infrastructure
nodes.description: Backend API, persistence, object storage, workers, jobs, deployment and security.

nodes.title: Safety and provenance
nodes.description: Licensing, patient de-identification, traceable origin, abstention and research-only boundary.

nodes.title: Dataset and licensing registry
nodes.description: Source identifier, version, DOI, license, acquisition date, restriction, attribution, approval.

nodes.title: ResearchPatient
nodes.description: Stable pseudonymous internal patient key; mapping to protected source patient key.

nodes.title: CancerDiagnosis
nodes.description: Verified subtype, stage, grade, ER/PR/HER2 and breast side; unknown stays unknown.

nodes.title: ClinicalVisit
nodes.description: Clinical encounter with timestamp and links to observations; do not conflate visit and scan.

nodes.title: ImagingStudy
nodes.description: Study with modality, source UID, scan date and acquisition context.

nodes.title: ImagingSeries
nodes.description: Acquisition/contrast phase with orientation, spacing, origin and physical coordinate transform.

nodes.title: SegmentationArtifact
nodes.description: Mask whose semantics, source image, class, quality and provenance are known.

nodes.title: Lesion
nodes.description: Persistent lesion identity with verified or reviewed cross-visit correspondence.

nodes.title: TumorMeasurement
nodes.description: Method-defined longest diameter/volume and unit; volume distinct from RECIST diameter.

nodes.title: LaboratoryResult
nodes.description: Collection time, analyte code, value, unit, source and reference metadata.

nodes.title: VitalSign
nodes.description: Date, physiologic value, unit and provenance.

nodes.title: SymptomObservation
nodes.description: Structured symptom with explicit severity scale, negation and date.

nodes.title: TreatmentEvent
nodes.description: Time-indexed exposure category, known status, regimen/setting where available.

nodes.title: ClinicalNote
nodes.description: Source text or synthetic note with context, negation and evidence spans.

nodes.title: OutcomeObservation
nodes.description: Recorded real endpoint or synthetic state; pCR distinct from MRI response.

nodes.title: ProvenanceRecord
nodes.description: Real observed, real derived, synthetic generated, interpolated or model predicted with parent, version and hash.

nodes.title: SimulationBranch
nodes.description: Immutable hypothesis path originating from real baseline; never overwrites actual history.

nodes.title: SimulationRun
nodes.description: Versioned generator settings, seed, status, logs and validator outcomes.

nodes.title: Artifact
nodes.description: Source DICOM, NIfTI, mask, mesh or report with checksum, access control and transformations.

nodes.title: DICOM and NIfTI ingestion
nodes.description: Validate study, series, sequence, privacy, slice sorting, pixel geometry and checksums.
acceptance: Valid real breast MRI imports with source metadata

nodes.title: MRI preprocessing
nodes.description: Resampling, orientation standardization, intensity normalization, crop and transforms are versioned.

nodes.title: Mask classification and import
nodes.description: Expert segmentation versus analysis ROI versus bounding box; masks must represent claimed structure.

nodes.title: Optional automated segmentation
nodes.description: Use validated masks first; nnU-Net/MAMA-MIA only when weights, domain and outputs verified.
acceptance: Independent held-out mask evaluation if deployed

nodes.title: Quantitative measurement
nodes.description: Compute mask volume using physical voxel geometry; derive only supported dimensions.

nodes.title: Longitudinal registration
nodes.description: Use rigid/affine as warranted, explicit quality gate; numerical comparisons may survive registration failure.

nodes.title: Cross-visit lesion identity
nodes.description: Curated or verified lesion association across genuine studies, never inferred from proximity alone.

nodes.title: Mask-to-mesh conversion
nodes.description: Marching cubes or tested equivalent; apply physical transform and preserve mask-authoritative measurements.
acceptance: Mesh dimensions agree with physical mask

nodes.title: Synthetic lesion geometry
nodes.description: Transform baseline mask to target volume with validated geometry, label synthetic; no fabricated follow-up MRI.
acceptance: Synthetic target volume achieved within configured tolerance

nodes.title: Web MRI viewer
nodes.description: OHIF/Cornerstone3D integration or tested alternative for authentic MRI and overlays.

nodes.title: Immutable real baseline
nodes.description: The source patient and measurements remain authentic, and untouched by any simulated branch.

nodes.title: Time-indexed state
nodes.description: State binds patient, timestamp, geometry, clinical observations, treatment events, quality, missingness and provenance.

nodes.title: Append-only historical updates
nodes.description: Adding new observation creates new data/version, triggers selective downstream reanalysis.

nodes.title: Scenario branch isolation
nodes.description: All branches share source baseline but maintain isolated descendant records.

nodes.title: Timeline alignment
nodes.description: Different scan, lab, symptoms and intervention dates are retained even in a selected visit summary.

nodes.title: Change analysis
nodes.description: Compare appropriate lesion and clinical values with units, comparability and uncertainty.

nodes.title: Genuine longitudinal viewing
nodes.description: At least one real repeated-imaging case, kept separate from hypothetical trajectories.

nodes.title: Treatment and scenario eligibility
nodes.description: Known receptor status, setting and assumptions gate plausible exposures; unknown cannot silently pass.

nodes.title: Family 1: strong response
nodes.description: Hypothetical sustained tumor shrinkage, independent adverse effects.

nodes.title: Family 2: partial/stable
nodes.description: Hypothetical small reduction or near stability, measurement noise separate.

nodes.title: Family 3: progression
nodes.description: Hypothetical increasing burden; not automatically confirmed resistance.

nodes.title: Family 4: response then regrowth
nodes.description: Hypothetical reduction followed by growth, preserve intermediate inflection.

nodes.title: Family 5: clinical deterioration
nodes.description: Potential worsening labs/symptoms independent of tumor burden, not proven drug causality.

nodes.title: Treatment exposures
nodes.description: Chemo, endocrine, HER2 targeted, selected immunotherapy, surgery/radiotherapy as time-indexed events.

nodes.title: Latent evolution state
nodes.description: Simulated underlying tumor burden and clinical condition separated from noisy measurement generator.

nodes.title: Observation simulation
nodes.description: Timestamped labs, vitals, symptoms, imaging geometry, notes, irregular sampling and missingness.

nodes.title: Reproducibility
nodes.description: Pinned simulator, parameters, seed, source baseline, configuration hash.

nodes.title: Simulation validation
nodes.description: Reject structural, temporal, unit, cross-modal, geometry, provenance and unsafe interpretation failures.

nodes.title: Cohort branching target
nodes.description: Initial planning up to 100 unique baseline patients, five branches each, four dated states; not independent real patients.

nodes.title: Deterministic multimodal features
nodes.description: Measurements and comparisons computed by typed services, not hallucinated by LLM.

nodes.title: Clinical note extraction
nodes.description: Extract typed, supported facts with date, negation, certainty and source span.

nodes.title: Late multimodal fusion
nodes.description: Combine imaging, labs, vitals, symptoms, notes, treatment and missingness with provenance, conflict status.

nodes.title: Temporal analysis
nodes.description: State history, trends and baselines, irregular intervals and known input scope.

nodes.title: Optional future-state forecasts
nodes.description: Only with qualified independent real-data evaluation; abstain otherwise. Synthetic simulator is not predictive validation.

nodes.title: Clinical knowledge representation
nodes.description: Versioned source-linked relationships among observed patient entities and curated medical concepts.

nodes.title: Evidence retrieval
nodes.description: Curated NCI/PubMed-type sources, verifiable passage IDs, publication version and permissions.

nodes.title: Grounded explanation
nodes.description: Structured interpretation referencing exact measurements, provenance, evidence, uncertainty and limits.

nodes.title: Output safety validation
nodes.description: Numerical grounding, citation validity, hallucination/unsafe claims, prompt-injection defense, abstention.

nodes.title: AI outage tolerance
nodes.description: Twin measurements and viewing continue when external model is unavailable.

nodes.title: Research case browser
nodes.description: Pseudonymous case listing, source metadata, completeness and access.

nodes.title: Patient context
nodes.description: Known subtype/receptor, available studies, visits, uncertainty and source.

nodes.title: Interactive lesion viewport
nodes.description: Rotate, pan, zoom, reset; clearly distinguish observed/synthetic/illustrative geometry.

nodes.title: Observation/date selector
nodes.description: Synchronize 3D, clinical charts, date, treatment markers and state provenance.

nodes.title: Scenario generation/exploration
nodes.description: Select eligible case, treatment exposure and 5 families; show assumptions, progress, validation and branches.

nodes.title: Clinical charts
nodes.description: Labs, vitals, symptoms, treatments with units and exact observation dates; no invented readings.

nodes.title: AI insights with evidence
nodes.description: Findings with source links, uncertainties, conflicts and research-only limitation.

nodes.title: New observation workflow
nodes.description: Validate added clinical or image observation; append state and recompute dependencies.

nodes.title: Evaluation/limitations view
nodes.description: What was tested, real versus synthetic metrics, cohort size, unknowns and known failures.

nodes.title: Graceful empty/error states
nodes.description: No nonfunctional controls, sensible missing-image state, no stale insight falsely current.

nodes.title: Backend API contracts
nodes.description: Typed FastAPI/other selected API, auth, versioning and error contracts.

nodes.title: Clinical database
nodes.description: PostgreSQL logical entities, integrity keys, migrations and isolation.

nodes.title: Imaging/object storage
nodes.description: Private originals, derivatives, meshes, signed read paths and checksums.

nodes.title: Async imaging jobs
nodes.description: Bounded-memory CPU preparation, remote GPU when needed, status, retry and idempotence.

nodes.title: Deployment
nodes.description: Reproducible build, health checks, secure secrets, cost and demo recovery.

nodes.title: Continuous verification
nodes.description: Unit/integration/e2e tests, static checks, version pinning and audit logs.

nodes.title: Geometry phantom tests
nodes.description: Known millimeter cubes/ellipsoids to verify units, transforms, mask volume and mesh.

nodes.title: Imaging segmentation metrics
nodes.description: Dice, HD95, measured volume error on relevant held-out expert masks, no unsupported claims.

nodes.title: Authentic longitudinal case evaluation
nodes.description: Track genuine repeat scans separately; error against actual holdout outcomes if forecasting used.

nodes.title: Simulation integrity evaluation
nodes.description: Plausibility review, parameter assumptions, correlations, chronology, reproducibility and missingness.

nodes.title: NLP/LLM grounding evaluation
nodes.description: Extraction, negation, citation validity, numerical fidelity, clinical abstention and adversarial notes.

nodes.title: End-to-end demo
nodes.description: One MRI → mask → measurable mesh → five synthetic scenarios → timeline → AI interpretation.

nodes.title: Scientific limitations report
nodes.description: Cohort size, methods, source licenses, real/synthetic distinction and unvalidated claims.

nodes.title: Immutable source truth
nodes.description: Original observed records never silently altered or overwritten.

nodes.title: Five provenance classes
nodes.description: REAL_OBSERVED, REAL_DERIVED, SYNTHETIC_GENERATED, INTERPOLATED, MODEL_PREDICTED.

nodes.title: Privacy and access
nodes.description: Pseudonyms, deidentification checks, role-aware access, approved external data processing only.

nodes.title: License separation
nodes.description: Check source-code, dataset, model-checkpoint and outputs independently; CC BY-NC use needs review.

nodes.title: No autonomous care
nodes.description: No diagnoses, prescriptions, therapy ranking, survival promises or fabricated clinical efficacy.

nodes.title: Formal response boundary
nodes.description: Tumor volume labels never automatically RECIST categories or pathology complete response.

nodes.title: Adverse-event grading boundary
nodes.description: CTCAE grade only when exact evidence and versioned rule requirements satisfied.

nodes.title: Disclose unknowns
nodes.description: Missing values, poor registration, lack of calibrated forecast or uncertain evidence yield caveat/abstention.

nodes.description: Explicitly outside the hackathon prototype scope.

nodes.description: Explicitly outside the hackathon prototype scope.

nodes.title: MAMA-MIA
nodes.description: Inspect breast MRI masks and checkpoint compatibility; no unverified model claim.

nodes.title: nnU-Net
nodes.description: Adopt supported segmentation inference when feasible.

nodes.title: 3D Slicer
nodes.description: Cross-check source-space geometry and surface/volume calculations.

nodes.title: OHIF/Cornerstone3D
nodes.description: Investigate reusable browser DICOM viewer and longitudinal mode.

nodes.title: MONAI
nodes.description: Medical image transforms, evaluation, optional annotation/inference.

nodes.title: IDC Index
nodes.description: Reproducible imaging manifests and subset acquisition.

nodes.title: dcmqi
nodes.description: DICOM SEG and TID1500 interoperability where required.

nodes.title: Textbook and clinical standards
nodes.description: ITK, MIT imaging lectures, NCI breast PDQ, RECIST, CTCAE, Stan, IBSI, TRIPOD-LLM.
